scope: Single-photo scene reconstruction, object placement and procedural evaluation

sources.title: MoGe-2
sources.use: Implemented dense geometry backend; camera-space points, normals and intrinsics

sources.title: Diorama: Unleashing Zero-shot Single-view 3D Scene Modeling
sources.use: Architecture reconstruction, CAD retrieval, object pose and joint layout optimization
sources.review_basis: Official project, ICCV publication and setup/inference README
sources.deployment: Not run here; official setup combines multiple GPU libraries, pretrained components and asset retrieval

sources.title: Mira-Scene: Pixel-Aligned Layouts for Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction
sources.use: Canonical-to-scene pixel correspondences for object alignment
sources.review_basis: Author paper and project link; not locally benchmarked
sources.deployment: Research candidate; no local accuracy or speed claim

sources.title: Unravel: Recovering an Interactive 3D Scene from a Single Image
sources.use: Occlusion-aware deconstruction, support-order recomposition and placement audits
sources.deployment: Public quickstart says coming soon at review date

sources.title: SAM 3D Objects
sources.use: Independent completed object meshes from image regions
sources.deployment: Not run here; official setup requests Linux, at least 32 GB VRAM and gated checkpoint access

sources.title: BlenderProc
sources.use: Larger photorealistic procedural rendering and evaluation datasets
sources.deployment: Design reference; current benchmark is implemented in the existing Unity editor

sources.title: ProcTHOR
sources.use: Procedural indoor scene diversity for embodied-AI evaluation
sources.deployment: Design reference; not used to generate the measured eight-room dataset
